description: Use remote-agent PR feedback as ordinary review-batch input, retaining all existing finding gates and repairs, replying after disposition, and reviewing each fix-bearing HEAD before settlement.

steps.label: Review PR Candidates And Repair Valid Findings
Run PR Feedback Through Existing Review Batch Gates
Reply To Findings After Disposition And Repair
Repeat Only For Useful Review Of A Changed Candidate
steps.question: Read the current batch target snapshot, applicable gates and dispositions, repair evidence, outcome and PR reply assessment, then current Git HEAD for each target. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer no for a verified new committed fix-bearing HEAD needing pinned remote review when safe publication and observation are available. Also answer no for a newly arrived potential-issue source comment requiring disposition, including one ultimately rejected or duplicate, when it has not yet had its one same-head gates-only pass. Reuse the existing launch in that pass: no request, push or description refresh. An existing authoritative applicable disposition permits the reply owner to answer a late duplicate directly. Never repeat the same comment's gates-only pass, reopen disposed or exhausted findings without material new evidence, or repeat an unchanged candidate's launch. Failed or ambiguous posting, missing evidence, and unchanged unavailable coverage do not justify repeating; preserve uncertainty for settlement rather than claiming clean coverage. A changed candidate invalidates old clean coverage; independently useful changed targets must still be processed.
